INSERT INTO ydsz_msg_offline (id, user_id, msg_type, payload, msg_timestamp, status, pushed_at, expired_at, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted, tenant_id) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.userId}, #{item.msgType}, #{item.payload}, #{item.msgTimestamp}, COALESCE(#{item.status}, 'PENDING'), #{item.pushedAt}, #{item.expiredAt}, COALESCE(#{item.createdBy}, 'SYSTEM'), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, COALESCE(#{item.updatedBy}, 'SYSTEM'), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, COALESCE(#{item.deleted}, 0), COALESCE(#{item.tenantId}, '1'))
